capabilities: Track typed vs pasted text via CodeMirror transaction events
Mark selections as AI, self, or reference via commands
Highlight authorship in the editor with distinct styles
Store authorship ranges as Markdown Annotations at file end
Validate file integrity with SHA-256 hashes
extras: Not yet available in the Community Plugins directory (listed as 'coming soon'); must be installed manually or via BRAT. States it is 100% local with zero network calls and MIT-licensed.
intentEvidence: Inspired by iA Writer's Authorship feature.
problem: Obsidian gives no indication of where note text came from, so typed, pasted, and AI-generated content look identical in the editor.

relations.evidence: Inspired by iA Writer's Authorship feature.
Compatible with the open Markdown Annotations spec (v0.2).

summary: Authorship tracker that distinguishes typed, pasted, AI-generated, and reference text in the editor with color-coded highlights stored as Markdown Annotations.
